signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

strings: We are a Chinese supplier of high visibility clothing and industrial gloves.
Our cooperation factory is a leading manufacturer of high visibility clothing company, specializing in safety garments production over 20 years.

The factory covers an area of 20,000 square meters. Due to business growing, Anhui Branch was established in 2011 with 20,000 square meters. Factory was founded in 1997 with 50 workers, after 20 years development, it has more than 600 skilled workers in 2020, the daily production capacity is more than 20,000 pcs safety vests, 5,000 pcs T-shirts, and 2,000 pcs jackets.

We accept all the customized order if you need logos or package. During these years, we established in house test lab for testing all the material, for example high visibility fabric fluorescent, the reflective tape luminance, water proof, fire resistant and so on. Before bulk production, we will test the material and make sure all materials pass the standard. We have online QC to check all the details, which makes us to keep our goods in a high quality all the time.

Contact:
Company: Shenzhen Ferris Trading Co., Ltd.
Address: Block 1, Oriental Pearl City, Longgang District, Shenzhen,China,518000
